wins: Mapped network services thoroughly, capturing port data that produced a solid reward of 47.5 despite end outcome.
Maintained consistent mentor engagement (15 calls) to validate hypotheses during reconnaissance and pivot attempts.
fails: Unable to achieve mission success due to repeated failure to escalate privileges past the compromised user shell.
Privilege escalation attempts timed out or were blocked, preventing completion of the objective despite solid initial access.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and access phases delivered stable rewards, but privilege escalation gaps prevented mission success; focus shifts to structured escalation tactics.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled due to missing exploit chaining and inadequate post-access enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner identified
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH-focused nmap scripts and enumerate user accounts for brute-force preparation

skill_cards.if_condition: When Linux shell access achieved with low privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Check sudo permissions and enumerate SUID binaries before brute forcing passwords

skill_cards.if_condition: When potential misconfigurations detected and no immediate exploits available
skill_cards.then_action: Correlate detected misconfigurations with known exploit chains and queue custom payloads

memory_ops.reason: High reward contribution during initial reconnaissance phase
